method: Actual Stir, then thirty native water seconds on three seeds and equal-density controls. Current native positions, affine state, material flags and reference masses are copied from GPU buffers. Twenty-second requestAnimationFrame deltas with vsync off are measured separately, with advancing native clock. Cold motion uses normal vsync and cache disabled on a local server.
behaviorScope: The two materials move past each other; density contrast gives stronger upward oil stratification after Stir than the equal-density comparison. The control still sorts partly, so density is not the sole source of separation.

model.stress: One-sided linear hard-knee reference-occupancy EOS; the ordinary water C1 hinge is not active here.
model.exchange: Separate phase momentum with implicit equal and opposite drag; native spatial and transport stability filters retained per phase.

indicator: Mean oil y is at least 12 world pixels above mean water y, and more than 65 percent of oil is in the fixed upper region. Screen y increases downward.

coldStart.scope: Actual displaced interfaces and motion onset before three wall seconds, not completed layer inversion.
Actual displaced interfaces and motion onset before three wall seconds, not completed layer inversion.

limits: The compressible fluid does not have calibrated viscosity, incompressibility, interfacial tension or an immiscibility law. Pale oil remains along some lower walls; a clean settled interface is not promised.
Water and oil numerical filters and exclusions differ; matched density controls retain partial sorting.
Implicit drag conserves pair momentum and dissipates relative motion, but filtering, clipping, pressure, spacing and contact work do not have a closed total mechanical ledger.
No supply, drain, replenishment, particle retirement or material retagging occurs in this jar.
Native observations use queued GPU copies; subsequent CPU mirror time can advance separately. No exact same-clock mirror theorem is claimed.
Cold observations precede the final frame-bank routing fix; normal 60 Hz routing and physical source are unchanged. Final advancing-clock frame and pointer checks use the release host.
Phone layout and timing use desktop-host emulation, not physical phone GPU measurements. Sand sorting and ice are separate unfinished items.
